# Emitted CUDA twins (`cuda/emitted/`)

**Do not hand-edit.** Sources here are generated by `parcae-compile` from theory
DSL IR (see [`docs/architecture/python-transpiler.md`](../../../../docs/architecture/python-transpiler.md)).

Hand-written catalog twins remain in the parent [`../`](../) directory
(`CaesarKernel`, `FamilyChi2Batch`, …).

## Style (HARD)

Generated public APIs **MUST** use top-level classes and header guards — **no**
C++ namespaces:

```cpp
#ifndef NAME_HPP
#define NAME_HPP
class Name {
public:
  // …
private:
  Name() = delete;
};
#endif // NAME_HPP
```

`__global__` kernels may live in an anonymous namespace **inside** `.cu` files
only (same convention as existing twins). Arithmetic must call `Z29Device`.

## Git policy

Generated `.hpp` / `.cu` under this folder are **gitignored**. This README is
kept so the directory exists in a fresh clone / VS tree.

Artifact manifests under `data/theories/<name>/<version>/` record relative paths
into this tree when CUDA sources are emitted.
